Here is the complete categorization of all 43 example files in `D:\code\ESI.ts\examples\`.

---

## Public (No Auth Needed) -- 22 files

These examples call only public ESI endpoints and can run immediately without any SSO token.

| # | File | What it demonstrates |
|---|------|---------------------|
| 1 | `status.ts` | Server status check |
| 2 | `character-lookup.ts` | Public character info, portrait, corporation |
| 3 | `universe-info.ts` | Solar system, station, constellation, region lookups |
| 4 | `market-prices.ts` | Global average prices and regional price history |
| 5 | `alliance-info.ts` | Alliance info, member corporations, icons |
| 6 | `wars.ts` | War IDs and war details |
| 7 | `industry.ts` | Public industry facilities, system cost indices, insurance prices |
| 8 | `incursions.ts` | Active incursions and faction warfare stats/systems |
| 9 | `rate-limiting.ts` | Rate-limiter demo using universe regions/types |
| 10 | `retry-timeout-metadata.ts` | Retry, timeout, and response metadata using public endpoints |
| 11 | `dogma.ts` | Dogma attributes, item type details |
| 12 | `route-planner.ts` | Route calculation between solar systems |
| 13 | `sovereignty.ts` | Sovereignty campaigns |
| 14 | `streaming-pagination.ts` | Streaming paginated market orders and market types |
| 15 | `dogma-meta-sov.ts` | Dogma effects, sovereignty systems, OpenAPI spec, war killmails |
| 16 | `universe-encyclopedia.ts` | Ancestries, bloodlines, races, factions, categories, groups, graphics, system jumps/kills, celestials |
| 17 | `universe-post-helpers.ts` | Bulk name-to-ID, ID-to-name, and character affiliation POST helpers |
| 18 | `mercenary.ts` | Mercenary dens and tactical operations |
| 19 | `skyhooks.ts` | Sovereignty hubs, orbital skyhooks, raidable skyhooks |
| 20 | `cursor-pagination.ts` | Cursor-based pagination with public freelance jobs listing/detail (auth endpoints are mentioned only in comments) |
| 21 | `character-profile.ts` | **Mostly public.** Character info, portrait, corp, alliance are public. The location endpoint is authenticated but degrades gracefully without a token (shows "unavailable"). Runs fine with no auth. |
| 22 | `contracts-browser.ts` | **Mostly public.** Public region contracts, auction bids, and items work without auth. The character-contracts section at the end gracefully skips with a message if `ESI_ACCESS_TOKEN` is not set. |

---

## Auth Required (Needs EVE SSO Token) -- 21 files

These examples require `ESI_ACCESS_TOKEN` (and in one case `ESI_REFRESH_TOKEN` / `ESI_SSO_CLIENT_ID`) set in the environment. They will fail or produce no useful output without authentication.

| # | File | Required scopes / what it accesses |
|---|------|------------------------------------|
| 1 | `assets-inventory.ts` | `esi-assets.read_assets.v1` -- character asset inventory |
| 2 | `fittings-clones.ts` | Fittings and clones -- multiple scopes |
| 3 | `fleet-operations.ts` | `esi-fleets.read_fleet.v1` -- fleet composition |
| 4 | `killmails.ts` | `esi-killmails.read_killmails.v1` -- character killmail summaries (detail lookup is public, but the initial list needs auth) |
| 5 | `location-tracker.ts` | `esi-location.read_location.v1` and related -- character location, ship, online status |
| 6 | `mail-inbox.ts` | `esi-mail.read_mail.v1` -- mail headers and bodies |
| 7 | `skills-overview.ts` | `esi-skills.read_skills.v1` -- character skills and queue |
| 8 | `wallet-overview.ts` | `esi-wallet.read_character_wallet.v1` -- wallet balance, journal, transactions |
| 9 | `token-refresh.ts` | Requires `ESI_ACCESS_TOKEN`, `ESI_REFRESH_TOKEN`, and `ESI_SSO_CLIENT_ID` -- demonstrates automatic token refresh via EVE SSO |
| 10 | `contacts.ts` | `esi-characters.read_contacts.v1` -- character contacts |
| 11 | `calendar-search.ts` | Character calendar events |
| 12 | `character-details.ts` | Multiple authenticated character endpoints (medals, titles, standings, agent research, fatigue, notifications, etc.) |
| 13 | `corp-contracts-wallet.ts` | Corporation contracts and wallet -- requires director roles |
| 14 | `corporation-details.ts` | Corporation blueprints, divisions, facilities, medals, members, roles, shareholders, standings, structures -- requires director roles |
| 15 | `industry-mining.ts` | Character industry jobs, mining ledger, corp industry jobs, moon extractions, mining observers, corp killmails |
| 16 | `loyalty-pi.ts` | Loyalty point balances, planetary colonies, colony layouts, customs offices (LP store offers and PI schematics are public, but the example is structured around the auth endpoints) |
| 17 | `market-orders.ts` | Character market orders, order history, corporation orders, structure market orders |
| 18 | `access-lists.ts` | Access list (ACL) entries -- requires access-lists scope |
| 19 | `write-operations.ts` | Write operations: contacts (add/edit/delete), fittings (create/delete), mail labels (create/delete), mail (send/update/delete), UI endpoints -- requires multiple write scopes |
| 20 | `freelance-jobs.ts` | `esi-characters.read_freelance_jobs.v1`, `esi-corporations.read_freelance_jobs.v1` -- character and corporation freelance jobs |
| 21 | `faction-warfare-details.ts` | **Mixed.** Public leaderboards and faction wars work without auth, but character FW stats and corporation FW stats require authentication. The file header says "REQUIRES AUTHENTICATION for character/corporation stats." Will produce partial output without auth but the auth-dependent sections will throw errors or skip. |

---

## Summary

- **22 public** -- can run right now with no configuration
- **21 auth-required** -- need `ESI_ACCESS_TOKEN` at minimum
- 2 files in the "public" group (`character-profile.ts`, `contracts-browser.ts`) and 1 in the "auth" group (`faction-warfare-details.ts`) are technically **mixed** -- they have both public and authenticated sections, but the public ones gracefully degrade while the auth-required one is primarily structured around authenticated calls.
